requirements.statement: Bind Stage 8 to the exact PR 16 head, squash commit, sole parent, tree, exact-head CI, immutable artifact, and post-merge main CI.
Prove the validated PR 16 head tree equals the Stage 7 squash-merge tree.
Byte-freeze Stage 7 authorities and validate the downloaded evidence envelope and checksums.
Verify the one-parent Part 1-to-Part 2 Stage 7 closure lineage without gaps or alternate parents.
Preserve every frozen v1 schema, accepted v2 schema, inherited authority, and historical closure record.
Reproduce each accepted Part 2 stage from its exact immutable closure checkout.
Normalize all historical Part 2 trace formats without editing their source authorities.
Audit all 175 historical and 28 Stage 8 requirements with unique complete forward and reverse traceability.
Reject missing, duplicate, unknown, unowned, or non-contiguous requirement identities.
Audit all 59 historical and 10 Stage 8 gates with one deterministic adjudication each.
Preserve implementation ownership while distinguishing later verification and promotion evidence.
Require zero open, orphaned, duplicated, critical, or major gate findings.
Adjudicate exactly the six master Part 2 completion gates from their frozen owners and evidence.
Keep Stage 6 as failure-behavior owner while treating Stage 7 as exhaustive failure-matrix verification evidence.
Reject any master-gate promotion supported only by documentation, local assertion, or candidate evidence.
Run the complete Stage 8 audit twice in independent clean exact CPython 3.11.13 environments.
Re-run genuine Spark 3.5.6 and Py4J 0.10.9.7 validation under Java 17 with ANSI mode, UTC, and equal interpreters.
Build and install reproducible wheels and require equal deterministic audit payloads across clean runs.
Require formatting, lint, strict typing, complete tests, zero skips, and 100 percent Stage 8 statement and branch coverage.
Kill every registered Stage 8 semantic mutation and preserve all 116 accepted Stage 2-to-Stage 7 mutation results.
Synchronize active README, project status, execution contract, and completion documentation without rewriting historical snapshots.
Keep AWS, managed reconciliation, performance, scale, production operation, and overall project completion explicitly unclaimed.
Keep automatic CI read-only with no OIDC token, AWS action, AWS API, workflow dispatch, or infrastructure mutation capability.
Bind the immutable Stage 8 CI evidence envelope to the raw draft pull-request head and exact Stage 7 base.
Inspect artifact identity, manifest, checksums, counts, versions, boundaries, and exact unsuperseded head before readiness.
Require manual squash merge, validated tree equality, and independent main CI for promotion.
Publish repository-resident post-merge evidence through a separate closure-attestation pull request.
Claim LOCAL_RECONCILIATION_VERIFIED only after both promotion and closure-attestation transactions satisfy exact-head, squash, and main-CI requirements.
